interpretations: Include films with `replacement_cost > 20.99`; for each rating, average each film’s `rental_rate / rental_duration`, then compare that average with the simple mean of the nonmissing rating averages.

queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.avg_rate_per_day,
  o.mean_rating_average,
  r.avg_rate_per_day - o.mean_rating_average AS difference
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_rate_per_day,
  (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) FROM rating_averages) AS mean_rating_average
FROM rating_averages
ORDER BY rating

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost < 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_rate_per_day,
  (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) FROM rating_averages) AS mean_rating_average,
  avg_rate_per_day - (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) FROM rating_averages) AS difference_from_mean
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_rate_per_day,
  mean_rating_average,
  avg_rate_per_day - mean_rating_average AS difference
FROM rating_averages
CROSS JOIN benchmark;
